mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) AS totalCount, IFNULL(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) AS totalAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'DRAFT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS draftCount, SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'APPROVING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approvingCount, SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'APPROVING' THEN o.total_amount ELSE 0 END) AS approvingAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approvedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rejectedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'CANCELED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS canceledCount, SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN o.total_amount ELSE 0 END) AS completedAmount FROM po_order o

SELECT o.status AS status, COUNT(1) AS count, IFNULL(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) AS amount FROM po_order o
GROUP BY o.status

SELECT
DATE_FORMAT(o.order_date, '%Y-%m-%d')
DATE_FORMAT(o.order_date, '%Y-%m')
AS period, COUNT(1) AS count, IFNULL(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) AS amount FROM po_order o
GROUP BY period ORDER BY period

SELECT
s.id AS dimId, s.supplier_code AS code, s.supplier_name AS name
u.id AS dimId, u.username AS code, u.real_name AS name
m.id AS dimId, m.material_code AS code, m.material_name AS name
o.dept_id AS dimId, IFNULL(d.dict_code, '') AS code, IFNULL(d.dict_name, '未分配部门') AS name
,
COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orderCount, IFNULL(SUM(i.qty), 0) AS qty, IFNULL(SUM(i.amount), 0) AS amount
COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orderCount, IFNULL(SUM(o.total_qty), 0) AS qty, IFNULL(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) AS amount
FROM po_order o
GROUP BY dimId, code, name ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT #{topN}

choose.when: JOIN base_supplier s ON s.id = o.supplier_id AND s.deleted = 0
JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = o.buyer_id AND u.deleted = 0
JOIN po_order_item i ON i.order_id = o.id AND i.deleted = 0 JOIN base_material m ON m.id = i.material_id AND m.deleted = 0
choose.otherwise: LEFT JOIN sys_dict d ON d.dict_type = 'dept' AND d.dict_code = CAST(o.dept_id AS CHAR) AND d.deleted = 0

mapper.select:
SELECT 0 AS dimId, '' AS code, '' AS name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orderCount,
IFNULL(SUM(i.qty), 0) AS qty, IFNULL(SUM(i.amount), 0) AS amount
IFNULL(SUM(o.total_qty), 0) AS qty, IFNULL(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) AS amount
FROM po_order o
